analysis.coverage: Full duration at overview density; the word-card burst at boundary level.

concept.observed: Product launch promo: a typed link becomes a short link, counters roll over a dotted globe, a dashboard draws, partners orbit a hub, then a burst of feature words and an end card with a call to action.
concept.interpreted: Shows the product's value as a sequence of fast, legible interactions.

communication_style.observed: No narration; short feature phrases with full stops; numbers counting up.

palette.observed: Measured #080808 (67%) dark with white UI; colour only in word-card backgrounds (gradients, orange).

typography.observed: Clean grotesk, sentence case with full stops; large numerals.

composition.observed: Centred UI fragments and cards on dark; hub-and-spoke orbit layout.

motion.observed: Typing, width compression into a pill, rolling digits, chart draws, card stacks, elliptical orbits.

timing_and_rhythm.observed: One long continuous scene (1.52-10.52 s), then word cards every about 0.25 s (10.52-12.00 s).
timing_and_rhythm.interpreted: Slow demonstration, then a rapid recap.

transitions.observed: Re-read 2026-11-27: 4 boundaries (2 cut, 2 grow, 0 cover, 0 continuous). 1.52 s grow: the typed line contracts to a glowing ember (1.30-1.50 s), one grey wash frame (1.53 s), then a pill grows from the centre and types its text (1.57-1.73 s): a small implode-and-burst. 10.75 s cut: white word card to a dark tile card through a two-frame dissolve (10.77-10.80 s) that reads as a cut. 11.50 s cut: dark outline-word card to a gradient card, the same two-frame dissolve. 12.50 s grow: reversed: after one light frame the mark arrives frame-filling and scales down to its end-card size in about 0.15 s (12.54-12.68 s). Earlier reading (2026-10-30): Continuous camera moves inside the UI section; hard cuts for word cards; mark scales into the end card.
transitions.interpreted: Cuts only inside the word list; the open grows out of a point and the close grows into the mark. Between 1.5 and 10.5 s there is no boundary: the UI section moves continuously.

depth_and_layering.observed: A dashboard card tilted in perspective; glowing dotted globe horizon.

audio_and_sync.observed: 3.7 onsets/s, tempo estimate 118 bpm (medium); boundaries not aligned with onsets above chance (0.25 vs 0.31).

sound_design.observed: Integrated -13.6 LUFS, LRA 1.7 LU, true peak -0.3 dBTP. Tempo estimate 118 bpm (medium). 12 accents (47.8 a minute), about 0.5 s apart (2.60, 3.09, 3.60, 5.09, 5.60, 6.08, 6.59, 8.59, 9.10, 9.59, 11.10, 11.59 s). Accents on cuts 0.25 against chance 0.15 (1 of 4); onsets near boundaries 0.25 against 0.31. No silences; head -16.9 dB (quiet intro), tail -5.1 dB. Listen sheet: accents on the rolling total's jumps (2.60-3.60 s), metric cards switching (5.09-6.59 s), partner pills popping round the hub (8.59-9.59 s), and on the closing word cards, which arrive on cuts (11.10, 11.59 s).
sound_design.interpreted: Accents carry the data changes on a half-second grid; only the closing word-card run puts them on cuts. A heavily compressed promo master.

narration.observed: None: dictation found 0 words in 15 s.
